planets.name: WASP-87 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-87 with a 1.68-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: WASP-87 b was found in 2016 by Anglo-Australian Telescope as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-87. Its orbit and size follow Addison et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname ADDISON_ET_AL__2016): disc_year 2016, disc_facility Anglo-Australian Telescope, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.68279422, pl_radj 1.385, pl_bmassj 2.18
